as_told.title: Fred Crisman, JFK 'three tramps' and the Maury Island incident

plain: The theory is that a man named Fred Crisman was one of three tramps arrested in Dallas just after President Kennedy was shot in 1963. Michels tells it, saying "they think" Crisman was one of the three. He adds that Crisman was also involved in a 1947 UFO episode known as the Maury Island incident, which happened around the time a pilot named Kenneth Arnold reported his own UFO. The researcher Peter Levenda says he "can corroborate" it and suggests that a man named E. Howard Hunt "might have been one of them as well." If true, it would tie the first wave of modern UFO stories to the Kennedy assassination through one man.
